summary_claims.claim: Review risks to human dignity, public order, life and health or the environment (Art. 2: 人的尊严、公共秩序、生命健康、生态环境、可持续发展)
Review focuses on well-being, fairness, controllability and trustworthiness, transparency and explainability, traceability of responsibility (责任可追溯), privacy (Art. 15 items 1-6)

Annex lists three kinds of R&D for expert re-review: human-machine fusion systems; algorithm models/apps/systems able to mobilise public opinion and guide social consciousness (舆论社会动员能力); highly autonomous automated decision systems for scenarios with safety or personal-health risk

Art. 27: emergency review generally completed within 72 hours (应急审查一般在72小时内完成); Art. 26 exemption from expert re-review; Art. 32 penalties under Cybersecurity, Data Security, PIPL and S&T Progress laws

scope.note: AI-specific ethics-review measures; ethics review of AI R&D is in scope under section 10.

note: All fields supported by the stored gov.cn page and the 12-page PDF. Own literal translation checked for the summary's specific claims: Art. 15(5) 责任可追溯 = 'traceability of responsibility' (log management to record data, algorithm, model and system information so the whole chain can be tracked); Art. 27 'Emergency review is generally completed within 72 hours'; annex item 2 'research and development of algorithm models, applications and systems with the capacity for public-opinion and social mobilisation and for guiding social consciousness'. The earlier word 'high-risk' for the three annexed categories was correctly dropped (the annex title is just 'list of AI activities requiring expert ethics re-review'). One targeted search for amendments or a replacement found nothing. english_version stays 'none found'.
